title: Early-Purchase Credit on a Keyturn Trip Booking Mileage Top-Up
content:
A guest who tops up the included miles on a Keyturn Trip Booking well before the trip ends, having already driven a good deal, is given a credit against the price of the top-up.

**Where more than 20 days of the reserved period are still to run and the reservation's odometer readings have booked more than 2000 miles**, the early-purchase credit is 40.00 USD.

**Where at least 8 days but not more than 20 days of the reserved period are still to run and those readings have booked more than 2000 miles**, the early-purchase credit is 20.00 USD.

**In every other case** no early-purchase credit is given.

### What is counted, and how the days are counted

The odometer readings counted here are the records the reservation's mileage record holds as readings of miles driven, which are the records that book miles against the allowance, and those alone; a reading of the fuel tank or the traction battery is not one of them whatever else it notes, and every reading of miles driven counts whoever took it — the marketplace's telematics, the host or the guest alike — since a reading that another supersedes books no miles against the allowance and so adds nothing to what the readings have booked.

The days of the reserved period still to run are counted from the day of handling to the scheduled return, the day of handling not counted and the day of return counted.

### The bands, on both of their sides

| Days of the reserved period still to run | Miles the reservation's readings have booked | Early-purchase credit |
|---|---|---|
| More than 20 | More than 2000 | 40.00 USD |
| At least 8 and not more than 20 | More than 2000 | 20.00 USD |
| Fewer than 8 | More than 2000 | None |
| Any | 2000 or fewer | None |

Twenty days still to run is not "more than 20", so it falls in the middle band and gives 20.00 USD; 21 days gives 40.00 USD. Eight days still to run is "at least 8" and gives 20.00 USD; 7 days gives none. The mileage limb is passed rather than reached: readings booking exactly 2000 miles give no credit, and readings booking 2001 miles satisfy it.

*Hypothetical.* A reservation with 26 days still to run whose readings have booked 2900 miles carries a credit of 40.00 USD. The same reservation with 11 days still to run carries 20.00 USD, and with 5 days still to run carries none. A reservation with 26 days still to run whose readings have booked 1400 miles carries none, because the mileage limb fails.
